name: Kreatív Mail for WooCommerce
author: Hajdú Lajos (Kreatívoldal)

sections.description:
Kreatív Mail is a Hungarian email marketing service. This plugin connects a WooCommerce shop to a Kreatív Mail account.

  • Newsletter consent at checkout. An unticked consent checkbox on the classic and the block checkout. Only customers who tick it are added to your Kreatív Mail list, tagged as buyers, so a post-purchase email series can start.
  • Greeting coupons. A button in your birthday or name-day email gives the subscriber a one-time, personal WooCommerce coupon.
  • Abandoned cart. If a subscribed customer leaves items in the cart, Kreatív Mail can send a reminder email. Optionally (off by default) also customers who entered their email at checkout but did not subscribe; they go to a separate list used only for cart reminders, never to your newsletter list.

The plugin’s interface is in Hungarian.

A Kreatív Mail fiókhoz kötött WooCommerce-bővítmény: a pénztárban hírlevélre feliratkozó vásárlókat felveszi a listádra, születés- és névnapi kupont ad, és jelzi az elhagyott kosarat.

External services

This plugin connects to the Kreatív Mail API (by default https://app.kreativmail.hu, configurable in the settings) to manage the subscribers of your own Kreatív Mail account. It sends data only after you have entered an API token.

  • When a customer who ticked the newsletter consent places an order (after payment): their email address is sent to look them up on your list. A new customer is added with the list ID, email address, first and last name. A customer who had unsubscribed is subscribed again only if the order is less than an hour old (they have just given consent). Then a tag (default: “vásárló”) is added.
  • When a subscriber clicks a coupon link in your email: the subscriber ID from the link is sent, to check that they are subscribed and that the coupon is due.
  • Abandoned cart (only if you enable it): when a cart with a known email address is left for the set number of hours without an order, that email address is sent (in the request body) to look it up on your list; unless you enable the option below, the service stores nothing about customers who are not subscribed. Only a customer who is already subscribed to the list gets the “kosárelhagyó” tag, which is removed again right away (the tag starts your abandoned cart email). If you enable “Nem feliratkozónak is” (also non-subscribers), a customer who is not on your newsletter list is added to the separate cart reminder list you set (email address only) and tagged the same way; customers who unsubscribed from your newsletter or from the cart reminder list are never added. If the cart reminder list is the same as your newsletter list, this option is ignored. Whether you may email them without prior consent depends on your local law; you are responsible for that choice.

Order data of customers who did not tick the consent checkbox is not sent to the service (with the optional abandoned cart mode, only their email address is, as described above).

Requires the Kreatív Mail service (app.kreativmail.hu); from 1.3.1 the plugin uses the subscriber lookup endpoint added in November 2026.

Service provider: Creative Pulse Kft. Terms of service: https://kreativmail.hu/aszf/ · Privacy policy: https://kreativmail.hu/adatkezeles/
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin. WooCommerce must be active.
  2. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Advanced → Kreatív Mail.
  3. Enter your Kreatív Mail API token and the UID of the list, then save.
sections.changelog:
1.4.0

  • Optional abandoned cart reminders for customers who did not subscribe, on a separate list (off by default).

1.3.1

  • Customer lookups send the email address in the request body instead of the URL, so it does not end up in server access logs.

1.3.0

  • Consent text based on legal advice; the consent is stored on the order.

1.2.0

  • Abandoned cart.

1.1.0

  • Birthday and name-day greeting coupons.

1.0.0

  • First release.
